feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: AcidGr/dsh-web-mobile-fix
entry.summary: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.

entry.title: AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access
entry.summary: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.

entry.title: Bernardxu123/dsh-mobile-gate
entry.summary: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).

entry.title: Noob-stupid/dsh-plugin-hub
entry.summary: A plugin management panel: one-click enable/disable for installed plugins plus a GitHub dsh-plugin marketplace with details and one-click installs.

entry.title: Make0209/dsh-usage-stats
entry.summary: GitHub-style usage heatmap dashboard: per-workspace turn counts and token spend (with cache-hit rate), DeepSeek account balance, and workspace aliases.

entry.title: zoumutou/dsh-cost-balance
entry.summary: Collapsible iOS-style stats pill under the composer: session cost, DeepSeek account balance, cache-hit rate, and token usage in a frosted panel.

entry.title: bowenliang123/dsh-context
entry.summary: Context insight panel: see what the model's context window is made of and how it evolves — composition vs. window size, per-request history, compression/injection events, and per-message token stats.

entry.title: wjy9902/dsh-web-default-session
entry.summary: The generic New Session action opens a default-directory workspace instead of requiring a folder pick, and the workspace picker lists that workspace as a no-folder choice.

entry.title: Fishsb/dsh-prompt-enhancer
entry.summary: One-click prompt enhancement: an independent LLM call rewrites your rough draft in the composer, fully undoable.

entry.title: openma-ai/deepseek-harness-tui
entry.summary: A Rust/ratatui terminal client that speaks the DSH SDK JSON-RPC protocol directly and runs standalone or as a profile bundle.

entry.title: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-animation
entry.summary: Persistent black whale-dive animation beside the DSH Web turn status, with a reduced-motion fallback and a seamless closed loop.

entry.title: 01Virex/dsh-status-rotator
entry.summary: Replaces the "Deep diving..." turn-status label with rotating meme-worthy phrases, with typewriter and gradient effects.

entry.title: asukasec/dsh-message-preview
entry.summary: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

entry.title: Nanki-nn/dsh-answer-pet
entry.summary: Animated blue-whale desktop pet with per-session response progress, model activity and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.

entry.title: GooodWei/arcana
entry.summary: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.

entry.title: GooodWei/context-vista
entry.summary: A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.

entry.title: taxueseek/dsh-files
entry.summary: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.

entry.title: l541402398/dsh-file-uploads
entry.summary: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.

entry.title: Ghost011118/dsh-balance-meter
entry.summary: DeepSeek account balance and session cost in the composer dock, with auto-fetched official pricing and peak/off-peak support.

entry.title: v587d/dsh-opencode-go-usage
entry.summary: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter
entry.summary: Per-session and daily API cost, budget with usage %, official balance, history dashboard, and one-click official price sync with peak/off-peak pricing.

entry.title: fishxcode/dsh-plugin-deepseek-balance
entry.summary: DeepSeek API balance, balance trend, and daily usage charts in DSH Web settings.

entry.title: Sev7een/ds-api-usage
entry.summary: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.

entry.title: nonewind/dsh-spend
entry.summary: Token usage and estimated spend for the dsh web UI: floating panel with per-model, per-day, and per-session stats.

entry.title: stevenx65/dsh-balance-plugin
entry.summary: DeepSeek balance and token usage in the web sidebar, with a today/all-time toggle and provider filtering.

entry.title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI
entry.summary: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.

entry.title: omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar
entry.summary: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.

entry.title: tsonglew/dsh-workspace-search
entry.summary: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.

entry.title: tsonglew/dsh-media-preview
entry.summary: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-sticky-disclosure
entry.summary: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
